'''Volume 18''' is the eighteenth volume published by [[VIZ Media]] compiling chapters from the {{MangaArc|Black & White}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga created by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and [[Satoshi Yamamoto]]. As part of VIZ Media's ''Pokémon Black and White'' series, the chapters in this volume have been collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures.

==Important events==
{{spoilers}}
* {{adv|Black}} and [[Iris]] battle each other in the first round of the semifinals.
* {{adv|Black}} defeats [[Iris]] and advances to the finals.
* {{adv|Cheren}} defeats [[Colress|Hood Man]] and advances to the finals.
* Angered at {{adv|Cheren}}'s strange behavior, {{adv|Black}} demands to battle his friend in the finals immediately.
* [[N's Castle|Team Plasma's castle]] begins moving from beneath the earth.
* {{adv|Black}} and {{adv|Cheren}} battle in the finals.
* {{adv|Cheren}} reveals that he has been influenced by [[Team Plasma]] and has chosen to follow their ideals so that he can gain strength.
* {{adv|White}} finds out that [[Zinzolin]] is with [[Team Plasma]] and [[Colress|Hood Man]] is assisting him.
* {{adv|Looker}} captures [[Zinzolin]].
* {{adv|White}} attempts to warn {{adv|Black}} about [[Team Plasma]], but [[Colress|Hood Man]] captures her and takes her away.
* {{adv|Black}} defeats {{adv|Cheren}}.
* Angered at [[Team Plasma]]'s manipulating his friends, {{adv|Black}} awakens {{p|Reshiram}} and challenges Team Plasma to come out of hiding.

==Party changes==
===Evolutions===
* [[Musha]] returns to {{adv|Black}}, now evolved into a {{p|Musharna}}, in [[PS518|Cold Hard Truth]].
